title: Fix column tally always at bottom of column
Fix epic lane header: title colour and sticky offset
description:
Two visual bugs in bd-epic-lane, both one-line CSS fixes.

## Bug 1: Epic title is blue (should be normal text colour)
The .epic-title rule uses var(--bd-mocha-blue) which is the same colour as the In Progress column header. It should use var(--bd-mocha-text, #cdd6f4) so it looks like regular card text, not a highlighted element.

File: src/client/epic/epic-lane.ts
Change: .epic-title { color: var(--bd-mocha-blue, #89b4fa) } → color: var(--bd-mocha-text, #cdd6f4)

## Bug 2: Sticky epic header is offset ~32px below where it should be
The .epic-header uses top: var(--col-header-h, 2rem). This is wrong because position:sticky is relative to the nearest scroll container — which is .board-scroll in bd-board. .board-scroll already starts below .column-header-row, so top:0 means 'stick to the top of the scroll container', which is visually tight against the column header row. The current value adds an extra 2rem gap, causing cards to scroll beneath the header in a visible gap.

File: src/client/epic/epic-lane.ts
Change: top: var(--col-header-h, 2rem) → top: 0

## Tests
No new unit tests needed — both are single-property CSS changes. Run pnpm test to confirm no regressions. Verify visually with pnpm dev.

## Commit
git commit -m 'fix(ui): epic title text colour and sticky header top offset'

description: watcher.ts uses chokidar to watch .beads/ directory, debounced at 300ms. TDD approach: write tests first (tests/unit/watcher.test.ts) using vi.useFakeTimers to test debounce behaviour, then implement. Returns a cleanup function. Tests verify: rapid changes = one callback, quiet period = callback fires.
design: chokidar.watch('.beads/', {ignoreInitial:true}). Debounce using setTimeout/clearTimeout pattern — no lodash dependency. Watcher is created with a beadsDir path and onChange callback. Returns a cleanup function to stop watching.
acceptance_criteria: onChange fires once for a burst of rapid file changes within 300ms. onChange fires after 300ms quiet period following a change. Watcher cleanup function stops chokidar and prevents further callbacks. Works on macOS (FSEvents) and Linux (inotify).
close_reason: watcher.ts implemented TDD: chokidar + 300ms debounce, cleanup cancels pending callbacks, 6 tests pass

title: Implement bd CLI query wrappers (src/server/query.ts)
description: query.ts provides typed wrappers around bd CLI commands using execa. TDD approach: write tests first (tests/unit/query.test.ts), then implement. Key queries: list all epics, list tasks by status, get subtask counts per task. Uses bd sql --json or bd list --json. Mock execa in tests with vi.mock.
design: Use execa to spawn bd with --json flag. Parse stdout as JSON. Define TypeScript interfaces for Epic, Task, BoardState in this file or a types.ts sibling. Handle bd not found in PATH with a clear error message. bd manages Dolt server lifecycle transparently — no server start needed.
acceptance_criteria: getBoardState() returns typed BoardState with epics array and tasks grouped by status. Function throws descriptive error if bd not in PATH. Execa spawn errors are wrapped with context. All return types are explicit TypeScript interfaces (no any).
close_reason: query.ts implemented TDD: getBoardState() with ready/blocked split, subtask counts, error handling, 13 tests pass

title: Build Lit frontend with kanban board components
description: Lit web component frontend with a kanban board. State lives in board-store.ts (outside component tree), distributed via Lit Context API. Components are display-only and receive bead IDs as attributes/properties to look up their own data slice from context. Material Web Components for UI primitives. Four columns: Open (blocked tasks), Ready, In Progress, Done. Epics render as full-width swim lanes. Subtask progress shown as a tally (e.g. 2 of 10 complete) on task cards.
acceptance_criteria: Board renders columns and epic swim lanes. Task cards show title, ID, assignee, priority, subtask tally. SSE updates from the store reflect in the UI without page reload. Components are display-only — no state mutation in components.
close_reason: All frontend tasks complete: board-store, board/column, epic-lane, task-card, subtask-tally

title: Implement Hono server with SSE realtime updates
description: The server is the core runtime: serves the dashboard, queries beads data via bd CLI (execa), watches .beads/ for file changes (chokidar, debounced 300ms), and pushes board-update SSE events to all connected clients. Routes: GET /api/board (initial state), GET /events (SSE stream), GET /* (static files from dist/public/). Default port 3003.
acceptance_criteria: Server starts and serves index.html. /api/board returns typed board JSON. /events streams board-update on .beads/ file change. Changes debounced — rapid file writes trigger only one bd call. --open flag opens browser. --port overrides default 3003.
close_reason: All server tasks complete: query.ts, watcher.ts, sse.ts, app.ts, index.ts
